# podman-quadlet_secret (Resource)

Manages a Podman secret holding a sensitive value.

<a id="nestedblock--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Required:

- `value` (String, Sensitive) Secret value. Stored by Podman and never read back; changes recreate the secret.

Optional:

- `driver` (String) Podman secret driver. Defaults to file.
- `driver_opts` (Map of String) Options passed to the secret driver.
